item.title: You’ve come a long way, Bibi: Israel’s crucial election
item.description:
"Israel's pivotal election: Join us as we explore the country's shifting political landscape and what's at stake in this crucial vote, on our latest podcast episode, 'You've come a long way, Bibi'." (155 characters)
Alternatively, for a longer description: "Delve into Israel's high-stakes election with our expert analysis. From Netanyahu's legacy to the future of Israeli politics, tune in to 'You've come a long way, Bibi' for in-depth discussion and insight." (300 characters)
